name: PD 142 was established by Ordinance No. 17583, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 27, 1982. Ordinance No. 17583 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17583; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 142 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 142 was established by Ordinance No. 17583, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 27, 1982. Ordinance No. 17583 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 142 is established on property generally located along the east line of McCraw Drive, north of Farquar Drive. The size of PD 142 is approximately 1.17 acres. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-142.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Utilization of the Property must be in accordance with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 142A). (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.105.USES. A maximum of six single-family dwelling units are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Building Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.106.BUILDING HEIGHT. No dwelling unit may exceed a height of 30 feet. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Front Yard Setback
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.107.FRONT YARD SETBACK. A three-foot setback is required from the property line adjacent to the private street. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Side Yard Setback
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-142.108.SIDE YARD SETBACK. Side yard setbacks are not required except as follows:
(1)Lot 1. Five-foot setback from the ease property line.
(2)Lot 2. Five-foot setback from the east property line.
(3)Lot 3. Five-foot setback from the south property line.
(4)Lot 5. Five-foot setback from the east property line.
(5)Lot 6. Five-foot setback from the east property line. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Rear Yard Setback
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.109.REAR YARD SETBACK. No rear yard setbacks are required. Where a garage faces an access easement (“private alley”), the garage must be set back 15 feet from the access easement. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.110.LOT COVERAGE. Not more than 80 percent of the area of a lot may be covered by structures or buildings. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.111.PARKING. A minimum of two covered off-street parking spaces must be provided for each dwelling unit. Access to off-street parking for dwelling units is not allowed from the private street. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Perimeter Project Walls
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.112.PERIMETER PROJECT WALLS. A 12-foot-high masonry wall must be erected adjacent to the Dallas North Tollway as shown on the approved site plan. A six-foot wood and brick screening wall must be erected on the north property line. A six-foot wood and brick screening wall which exists on the south property line must be maintained. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Private Streets And Alleys
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.113.PRIVATE STREETS AND ALLEYS. Private streets and alleys must be constructed and maintained in accordance with the Dallas Development Code and other applicable city standards. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.114.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Utilization of the Property must be in compliance with the requirements of all other applicable codes and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.115.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.116.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy until there is full compliance with this article, together with all applicable provisions of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-142.117.ZONING MAP. PD 142 is located on Zoning Map No. G-7. (Ord. Nos. 17583; 25508)
